subject: Discovery insights + POC readiness grid — proposed scope & access
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lina Ortega <lina@carve.ai>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel@carve.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery insights + POC readiness grid — proposed scope & access

Hi Lina — thanks again for a focused call today. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight POC plan so we can lock next steps. I kept this intentionally short and actionable.

Key pain points you raised
- Latency spikes on classification workloads during peak batch hours (2–4x baseline).
- High cost per inference for nightly large-batch re-runs.
- Inconsistent hallucination on long multi-turn transcripts (customer support).

Goals for a successful POC
1) Reduce 99th-percentile latency for real-time sentiment/classification by 30% under 1s SLA.
2) Demonstrate 2x cost savings on nightly batch via batching/cache/quantization.
3) Validate prompt set for multi-turn transcript fidelity (F1 > 0.85 on our evals).

Proposed POC scope (4–6 weeks)
- Sandbox setup: shared VPC peering or temporary endpoint + test dataset (we'll provide an access matrix).
- Models: run two candidate open models (1x quantized) and Redwood routing to compare latency/cost.
- Eval: run your eval prompt set + our synthetic prompts (we'll share eval harness).
- Owners: Customer: Lina (PM), Miguel (Eng lead). Redwood: me (AE) + Soojin (solutions engineering) + Karthik (integration).
- Success metrics: 99p latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens, prompt-eval pass rate.

Access & next steps (please confirm)
1) Provide a sample dataset (anonymized) and a list of example transcripts — attach to Drive or share a temp S3 link.
2) Whitelist IPs or enable VPC peering (we'll share a minimal network checklist).
3) SSO/SAML contact if you require SSO to access the console.
4) Confirm a kickoff date window: week of Oct 4 is our recommended slot.

Attachments: stubbed SOW + a sample access matrix.

If that aligns, I’ll send a short mutual action plan and calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff with owners.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

From: Lina Ortega <lina@carve.ai>

Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Discovery insights + POC readiness grid — proposed scope & access

Thanks Markus — this is a very helpful summary. High level: yes, aligned. A couple clarifications and commitments from our side:

Clarifications
- Nightly cost target: we’d like to see at least 1.8x reduction (2x is ideal).
- Transcript fidelity: our internal NLU team will provide the ground-truth labels for the eval set; we'll expect Redwood to run on the same split.

What I can commit this week
- I will share an anonymized sample (approx 5k transcripts) by EOD Thursday.
- Miguel will be our technical lead for infra and will coordinate network/peering.
- SSO: we use Okta; I'll share the SAML admin contact.

Kickoff — week of Oct 4 works for us. Prefer Oct 5 morning PT.

A few open questions
1) Are there any data retention or logging defaults we should be aware of in the sandbox?
2) Do you support collecting token-level cost breakdowns for each route during the POC?

Looping in Miguel (he’s on this thread) to confirm technical availability.

-Lina
Lina Ortega
Product Manager, Carve.ai
lina@carve.ai

Hi Soojin, Karthik — forwarding the customer confirmation. Quick internal asks to get the sandbox ready once we get the sample data: 

Operational checklist (short)
- Security: confirm POC defaults for audit logs and retention (customer asked). Proposed: 30-day audit log retention with option to extend. Can you confirm compliance constraints?
- Network: need VPC peering guide + sample Terraform snippet for the Carve infra team. Miguel will request peering.
- Cost visibility: can we enable token-level cost breakdown and route-level telemetry in the sandbox workspace? This will be important to prove the 2x cost claim.
- Prompt evals: Soojin — can you draft the eval harness template (simple CSV + scoring script) we’ll run against their transcripts? Karthik — can you scope the minimal integration steps for sample S3 ingestion and credentials?

Proposed kickoff time: Oct 5, 09:30 PT (we said morning PT). If you’re blocked that week, propose alternatives.

Attachments: placeholder SOW and sample dataset header (I'll load the full files when Lina shares the data).

Thanks — Markus

Markus / Lina — quick confirm from the infra side. We can provide:
- Temp S3 bucket with 5k anonymized transcripts (I'll provide a pre-signed link).
- Okta SAML: I will create a test Okta app for Redwood and share SP/IdP metadata.
- VPC peering: our infra team prefers a peered VPC rather than opening IP ranges — we'll need the minimal CIDR and a Terraform snippet.

On the two open questions Lina raised:
1) Data retention: for the POC we want limited retention locally. Miguel (Carve) preference: 7 days log retention is acceptable for the sandbox; anything beyond requires a legal review.
2) Token-level cost breakdown: yes please — that telemetry is critical.

I attached a brief network checklist and a CSV header sample so you can validate fields. If that looks good, we are green to kickoff Oct 5 at 09:30 PT.

Thanks — Miguel
